source:
@@U00534@@
I'm not sure I understand.

@@U00536@@
You'll get the hang of it in time, once you've learned to analyze and classify.

@@U00538@@
All this confuses me so. I feel as if a millwheel were turning in my head.

@@U00540@@
Next, and before all else, you must tackle metaphysics— metaphysics that will put in your head ideas too vast for the human brain to consider. And whether they fit or whether they don't, doesn’t matter, really; you'll always come up with some pompous word or other you can use to describe them. Now: this first semester you must work according to an ironbound schedule. You'll attend five classes daily; you'll be there at the stroke of the bell, and no absences; you'll be prepared; you'll do your homework beforehand, and that way you'll know, without consulting the text, that the professor’s not adding things that aren’t in the book. And be certain you write down his every syllable as if it came straight from the Holy Ghost.

@@U00542@@
That you wont have to tell me twice! I can see the use of it.
translation:
@@U00534@@
我不确定我是否理解。

@@U00536@@
一旦你学会了分析和分类，你就会及时掌握它的窍门。

@@U00538@@
这一切让我很困惑。我感觉脑子里好像有一个水车在转动。

@@U00540@@
接下来，在所有其他事情之前，你必须解决形而上学——形而上学将在你的头脑中放入人类大脑无法考虑的巨大想法。不管它们是否合适，真的都不重要；你总会想出一些浮夸的词或其他可以用来描述它们的词。现在：第一个学期你必须按照严格的时间表工作。您每天将参加五节课；铃声一响，您就会到场，不会缺席；你会做好准备的；你会事先做好功课，这样你就知道，在不查阅课文的情况下，教授不会添加书中没有的内容。并且一定要写下他的每一个音节，就好像它直接来自圣灵一样。

@@U00542@@
你不必告诉我两次！我可以看到它的用途。
